subject: Implement heartbeat step with frozen-threshold idempotency
description:
In `capo/workflows/delegation.py`, add the heartbeat step per §5.13. On crossing each configured threshold (default 15m, 1h, 4h from `[heartbeat] intervals_seconds`), send a one-line milestone update to `parent_thread_id`. The threshold list is captured from config at delegation start time and frozen on the `delegations.heartbeat_intervals_json` column. Each sent threshold recorded in `delegation_heartbeats` with `(delegation_id, threshold_seconds)` PK.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] At delegation start, config's `[heartbeat] intervals_seconds` is captured into `delegations.heartbeat_intervals_json`.
- [ ] Workflow polls runtime; on crossing each frozen threshold, sends a one-line update via `amc_client.send` with idempotency key derived from `(delegation_id, str(threshold_seconds))`.
- [ ] `delegation_heartbeats` row inserted on each successful send (PK enforces no duplicate).
- [ ] Final completion notification ALWAYS sent regardless of threshold list (handled by `notify_user`, separate from heartbeat).

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Workflow restart between threshold crossing and send: idempotency key + PK prevent duplicate.
- [ ] Config edited while delegation in flight: frozen list still controls (no behavior change mid-flight).
- [ ] Delegation completes before next threshold: no extra heartbeat fired.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: synthetic 90-min run sends 15m, 1h heartbeats and final completion (3 messages total)
• Integration: restart between heartbeat fire and send → exactly one heartbeat per threshold

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.13, 7.3, 9.3
